For \(\gamma\gamma \to e^+e^-\), the threshold condition for a head-on collision is

\[
s = 4E_\gamma \epsilon \ge (2m_e c^2)^2 = 4m_e^2c^4
\]

so

\[
E_\gamma \ge \frac{m_e^2c^4}{\epsilon}.
\]

Using \(m_ec^2 \simeq 0.511\,\text{MeV} = 5.11\times 10^5\,\text{eV}\) and \(\epsilon = 10^{-3}\,\text{eV}\):

\[
E_\gamma \approx \frac{(5.11\times10^5)^2}{10^{-3}}\,\text{eV}
\approx 2.6\times10^{14}\,\text{eV}
= 2.6\times10^5\,\text{GeV}.
\]

Answer: B
